page.title: Guided Jet Ski Tour in Marbella: Explore the Coast at Speed

data.meta_description: Book a guided jet ski tour in Marbella from Puerto Banús. Explore the coast at speed with a licensed skipper. From €749 for 2h. Reserve now.

faq.q: What is included in a guided jet ski tour in Marbella?
faq.a: Every charter includes a licensed skipper, fuel, water, soft drinks, beer, white wine, cava, light snacks, insurance, safety equipment, and Spanish IVA (21%). On Tier A boats (Astondoa 40, Azimut 39) you get the full package for €749 per 2 hours or €2,299 per 8 hours. The jet ski itself is free on Mangusta 80 charters (minimum 4 hours).

faq.q: How long does a guided jet ski tour in Marbella last?
faq.a: You can book a 2-hour tour (€749) or an 8-hour full-day tour (€2,299) on Tier A boats. For the Mangusta 80, the minimum charter is 4 hours (€4,719) and includes a free jet ski. Longer custom durations are possible on request via WhatsApp.

faq.q: Do I need a jet ski licence to join the tour?
faq.a: No. Our guided tours are led by a licensed skipper who handles navigation and safety. You ride as a passenger on the jet ski or follow the skipper's instructions. For private jet ski hire without a guide, you would need a licence, but our tours are fully supervised.

faq.q: Where does the guided jet ski tour depart from?
faq.a: All tours depart from Puerto Banús, Marbella's famous marina. This puts you right next to the Golden Mile and the best coastal spots. The marina is easy to reach by car or taxi, and we'll confirm the exact berth when you book.

faq.q: What are the best stops on a Marbella jet ski tour?
faq.a: Typical stops include Cala del Faro, a secluded cove near Cabopino, and Cala Cortés, a quiet beach backed by cliffs. On an 8-hour tour you can head further south towards Estepona or north to Sotogrande, depending on sea conditions and your preferences.

faq.q: Can I bring my family or friends on the jet ski tour?
faq.a: Yes. Depending on the boat, you can bring up to 12 guests. The Astondoa 40 and Azimut 39 carry up to 9 and 11 passengers respectively. The Mangusta 80 (24m) takes 12 guests and includes a jet ski – ideal for groups who want to take turns riding.

faq.q: What is the best time of year for a jet ski tour in Marbella?
faq.a: The season runs from April to October, with sea temperatures averaging 18°C in spring and 24°C in summer. July and August offer the calmest waters and longest daylight hours. Early morning tours (10:00) tend to have the smoothest conditions and fewer boats.

faq.q: How do I book a guided jet ski tour in Marbella?
faq.a: You can book directly through our website or contact us via WhatsApp for availability and custom requests. For Tier A boats, the price is fixed at €749 for 2 hours or €2,299 for 8 hours. For other boats, we'll send a personalised quote within minutes.

data.body_html:
If you want to feel the wind in your hair and the spray of the Mediterranean on your face, a guided jet ski tour in Marbella is the way to go. Departing from Puerto Banús, these tours combine high-speed runs along the coast with leisurely stops at hidden coves. You don't need a licence – our licensed skipper handles everything. Choose a 2-hour blast for €749 or a full 8-hour day for €2,299 on our Tier A boats (Astondoa 40 or Azimut 39). All charters include fuel, drinks, snacks, insurance, and 21% IVA.

Why Book a Guided Jet Ski Tour in Marbella?

Marbella's coastline is made for exploration: 27 km of sandy beaches, rocky coves, and exclusive beach clubs. A guided tour means you can focus on the thrill, not the navigation. Our skippers know the best routes, the calmest water, and the most photogenic anchorages. Plus, you're never alone – if you want to switch between riding and relaxing, the boat is your base.

On a guided jet ski tour in Marbella, you'll see landmarks like La Concha mountain looming over the coast, the luxury villas of the Golden Mile, and the golden sands of Cabopino. The tour is fully insured, and safety equipment is provided. No hidden costs – the price you see is the price you pay.

Our Fleet for Jet Ski Tours

We offer two ways to enjoy a jet ski tour:

  • Tier A boats (Astondoa 40, Azimut 39): 12.5m, 9–11 guests. 2h for €749, 8h for €2,299. Ideal for small groups.
  • Mangusta 80 (white or grey): 24m, 12 guests. Minimum 4h for €4,719, and a jet ski is included free. Perfect for larger parties.

All other boats (Ferretti 94, Canados 86, K80, Maiora 26m) are available for custom charters – just message us on WhatsApp for a quote. Every charter includes a licensed skipper, fuel, water, soft drinks, beer, white wine, cava, light snacks, insurance, and IVA.

What to Expect on a 2-Hour Tour

Your tour starts at Puerto Banús, where you'll meet your skipper and get a safety briefing. Then you're off – heading south past the beach clubs of Río Verde and towards Cala del Faro. The skipper will pick a route based on sea conditions, but you can expect speeds of up to 30–40 knots on the jet ski, with stops for swimming and photos.

At Cala del Faro, you'll find a quiet cove with crystal-clear water – perfect for a quick dip. After 30 minutes of relaxation, it's back on the jet ski for the return leg. The 2-hour format is ideal for a morning adrenaline hit or an afternoon escape.

Full-Day 8-Hour Guided Tour

For a deeper exploration, book the 8-hour tour on an Astondoa 40 or Azimut 39. You'll have time to reach Cabopino to the north or Estepona to the south. The skipper will customise the itinerary – maybe a long cruise to Sotogrande, lunch at a beach club, and multiple jet ski sessions. With drinks and snacks on board, you can make a whole day of it.

The 8-hour tour costs €2,299, which works out to less than €30 per person per hour if you fill the boat (11 guests). That's a solid deal for a private charter with a jet ski.

Mangusta 80 – The Ultimate Jet Ski Experience

If you want serious style and space, the Mangusta 80 (24m) is the flagship choice. It sleeps 12 guests and comes with a free jet ski. The minimum charter is 4 hours at €4,719 – perfect for a half-day of speed and luxury. The open flybridge gives everyone a great view, and the swim platform makes it easy to launch the jet ski.

You can also charter the grey Mangusta 80 for the same price. Both are docked at Puerto Banús, so you're steps away from the action. For larger groups, the Ferretti 94 (29m) or Canados 86 (26m) can be arranged – contact us for pricing.

Best Routes and Stops

Our skippers know the coast inside out. Typical stops include:

  • Cala del Faro: a sheltered cove near Cabopino, ideal for swimming.
  • Cala Cortés: a quiet beach with dramatic cliffs, east of Marbella.
  • Estepona: a pretty town with a lively marina, about 25 km west.
  • Sotogrande: exclusive marina with upscale beach clubs, 30 km south.

On a 2-hour tour, you'll likely do one or two stops. On an 8-hour tour, you can cover more ground. The skipper will always choose the safest and most scenic route based on weather.

What's Included in Every Charter

InclusionDetails
Licensed skipperProfessional and experienced
FuelUnlimited for the charter duration
DrinksWater, soft drinks, beer, white wine, cava
SnacksLight bites on board
Insurance & safetyFully insured, life jackets provided

No hidden extras. The only optional add-on is a private chef or catering, which we can arrange on request.

How to Book Your Guided Jet Ski Tour

Booking is straightforward. For Tier A boats, the price is fixed: €749 for 2 hours or €2,299 for 8 hours. For the Mangusta 80, it's €4,719 for 4 hours (jet ski included). For any other boat, send us a WhatsApp message and we'll get back to you with a personalised quote.

Check availability on our main charter page or explore other experiences like sunset cruises or private yacht charters. For a different thrill, see our flyboard sessions.
